title: CalculationSet
description: A saved, renderer-neutral explanation of an engineering calculation for one or more model elements.

CalculationSubject.title: CalculationSubject
CalculationSubject.description: The model elements or design group explained by the calculation set.

ElementType.description: The element type being explained, such as AMEStripFooting.

ElementIds.description: The IDs of the model elements that use this calculation.

Label.description: A short name shown to readers, such as a footing tag.

DesignGroupId.description: An optional ID for a group of elements that share one design.

CalculationSection.title: CalculationSection
CalculationSection.description: A named group of related calculation steps.

Title.description: The heading shown above this group of calculation steps.

Steps.description: The values, equations, checks, notes, tables, and figures in this section.

TwoColumn.description: Lay out this section's steps in two columns to save printed space.

FrontMatter.description: Print this section on a front-matter page ahead of its calculation set, such as a design basis or an index shared by a producer's calculation sets.

CalculationStep.title: CalculationStep
CalculationStep.description: One recorded value, equation, engineering check, note, table, or figure.

Title.description: The name shown for this calculation step.

Kind.description: How the step should be presented in a calculation report.

SymbolicEquation.description: The general equation written as LaTeX without surrounding math markers.

SubstitutedEquation.description: The equation with its actual values inserted, written as LaTeX without surrounding math markers.

Variables.description: The variables used by the equation and the values assigned to them.

Result.description: The numeric result already produced by the engineering calculation.

TextValue.description: A non-numeric result, selection, load combination, or yes/no setting.

Demand.description: The demand used by an engineering check.

Capacity.description: The available capacity used by an engineering check.

DemandCapacityRatio.description: The demand divided by the capacity, as calculated by the engineering function.

Comparison.description: A readable description of the comparison, such as demand less than or equal to capacity.

CodeReferences.description: Building-code or design-standard references used for this step.

Notes.description: Additional explanations or assumptions for this step.

Table.description: The table shown by a Table step.

Figure.description: The vector drawing shown by a Figure step.

Caption.description: Explanatory text printed below a table or figure.

CaptionItems.description: Bold-labelled explanations printed after the caption of a table or figure.

CalculationTable.title: CalculationTable
CalculationTable.description: A table of text cells. Values are formatted by the engineering function.

LinkColumn.description: A zero-based column whose cells name a design group. A cell links to the calculation set from the same source function with that DesignGroupId.

FlagColumns.description: Zero-based columns whose Yes or No cells are shown as a check mark or a cross.

MergedColumns.description: Zero-based columns whose cells span all rows of each row group. Only the first row's cell is shown.

RowGroups.description: Ranges of consecutive rows kept together on a printed page.

CalculationTableRow.title: CalculationTableRow
CalculationTableRow.description: One row of a calculation table.

Cells.description: The cell text, one entry per column.

Tooltip.description: Extra detail shown when a reader hovers over the row, such as a full element ID.

Highlight.description: Emphasize this row, such as the governing member or the selected trial.

CalculationTableRowGroup.title: CalculationTableRowGroup
CalculationTableRowGroup.description: A range of consecutive table rows kept together on a printed page.

Start.description: The zero-based index of the group's first row.

Count.description: The number of rows in the group.

Heavy.description: Draw a strong rule above the group.

Divided.description: Draw a thin rule between the group's rows.

CalculationCaptionItem.title: CalculationCaptionItem
CalculationCaptionItem.description: A bold label and its explanation, printed below a table or figure.

Text.description: The explanation that follows the label.

CalculationFigure.title: CalculationFigure
CalculationFigure.description: A vector drawing in drawing units. The producer scales its geometry into the Width by Height box; the origin is the top-left corner and Y increases downward.

Width.description: The drawing width in drawing units.

Height.description: The drawing height in drawing units.

Marks.description: The drawing marks, in drawing order.

CalculationFigureMark.title: CalculationFigureMark
CalculationFigureMark.description: One line, rectangle, text label, or polyline in a calculation figure.

Kind.description: The shape to draw. Line uses x1, y1, x2, y2; Rect uses x, y, width, height; Text uses x, y; Polyline uses x, y pairs.

Coordinates.description: The mark's coordinates in drawing units, as described for Kind.

Style.description: How the mark is drawn. Default is a dark outline; Accent is the brand blue; Light is a white fill; Highlight emphasizes the subject members in a key plan; Context is a muted neighbouring member; Grid is a dashed building grid line.

Text.description: The label for a Text mark.

CalculationVariable.title: CalculationVariable
CalculationVariable.description: A variable used in an equation and the value assigned to it.

Symbol.description: The variable symbol written as LaTeX without surrounding math markers.

Description.description: A plain-language explanation of the variable.

CalculationValue.title: CalculationValue
CalculationValue.description: A numeric value and its unit.

Unit.description: The unit for the value, or an empty string when the value has no unit.

CalculationStatus.title: CalculationStatus
CalculationStatus.description: The outcome of a calculation step or complete calculation set.

SchemaVersion.description: The version of the CalculationSet schema used to create this record.

SourceFunction.description: The Hypar function that performed the engineering calculation.

Sections.description: The ordered sections that make up this calculation set.
